"THAT was the most fun I've had in a while.  Good to make'a friend.  I'll clean up, yeah?  Swing by again sometime, maybe we can shoot the shit or work on somethin' togethah."
Great.  I already have a wicked prototype and some software, but I think it'll still take a bit.  Come back heah in two days?

responses.text: Sure, see you in two days.
